structure.unit: Requirements Applicable to Underground Coal Mines; Electricity, Safety, Etc

law.catch_line: Smoking in surface and other areas

text.section: No miner or other person shall smoke, carry, or possess any smoker's articles, or carry an open flame, in or near any magazine for the storage of explosive materials.
No miner or other person shall smoke in or around any oil house, tipple, or other surface area where such practice may cause a fire or explosion.
